SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Dua before and after waking up.. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What do you do after waking up. learner should be able to: the Dua for sleeping; (Bismika before sleeping?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain what Dua before and after waking up. means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Dua before and after waking up. from Kenya
3. practise Dua before and after waking up. in clear steps
4. apply Dua before and after waking up. in one real-life situation this week

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: DUA BEFORE AND AFTER WAKING UP.
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Dua before and after waking up. helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

PART 1: Explain what Dua before and after waking up. means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Dua before and after waking up. means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Dua before and after waking up. means in simple pupil language.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Dua before and after waking up.” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Dua before and after waking up. means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Dua before and after waking up. from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Dua before and after waking up. from Kenya. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Dua before and after waking up. from Kenya.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Dua before and after waking up. in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Dua before and after waking up. from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Dua before and after waking up. in clear steps

What this means

PART 4: Apply Dua before and after waking up. in one real-life situation this week

What this means

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Dua before and after waking up. in one real-life situation this week.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Dua before and after waking up.” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Dua before and after waking up. in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Dua before and after waking up. is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Dua before and after waking up.” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain what Dua before and after waking up. means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Dua before and after waking up. in your own words. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Dua before and after waking up. from Kenya)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: practise Dua before and after waking up. in clear steps)

Example 4: Show how “Dua before and after waking up.” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: apply Dua before and after waking up. in one real-life situation this week)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Dua before and after waking up. to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Dua before and after waking up. means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Dua before and after waking up. from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Dua before and after waking up. in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Dua before and after waking up. from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Dua before and after waking up.: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 2 learner study Dua before and after waking up.?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Dua before and after waking up. means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Dua before and after waking up. means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Dua before and after waking up. from Kenya.
